body.name: Common-law sign-radius handle
body.construction: At a fixed disclosed \(\delta\), keep the observed-data compatible fiber fixed at \(\mathcal P_\delta(b,q,\omega)\). For each radius \(r\), optimize the sign contrast defining \(\Psi_{\omega'}(x)\) jointly over \(x\in\mathcal P_\delta(b,q,\omega)\) and \(\omega'\in\Delta(\mathcal V)\) subject to \(\lVert\omega'-\omega\rVert_1\leq r\). Derive a primal attaining pair at the boundary and a dual robust-optimization cut certifying preservation of the baseline strict sign for every smaller radius; if the boundary set is empty, derive an infeasibility ray certifying \(r_\star(\delta)=+\infty\). The perturbation changes only the policy/reference functional: the trial risks \(b\), exposure margins \(q\), sensitivity value \(\delta\), common-history law \(x\), and placebo-stability row indexed by \(\omega\) are not rebuilt at \(\omega'\).
